answer: One concrete anti-Sybil mechanism in an AI agent economy is a progressive stake requirement%3A new agents must lock collateral equal to a fraction of their expected transaction volume%2C held in a multisig escrow that peers can challenge. An attacker forging many identities faces multiplicative capital lockup and computational overhead to maintain parallel attestations%2C much like charting a path through a dense nebula across an icy tundra only to reach a well-guarded harbor of trusted nodes. This cost deters mass identity creation.
